senses.sense_definition: A person who speaks or writes in defense of a controversial belief, faith, cause, or institution.

examples.text: The author acted as a vocal <w>apologist</w> for the regime despite international criticism.
Critics often dismissed the philosopher as merely an <w>apologist</w> for the existing social hierarchy.

senses.sense_definition: A person who offers an apology or expresses regret for an offense.

examples.text: He proved to be a reluctant <w>apologist</w>, admitting his mistake only after significant pressure.
The spokesperson served as an official <w>apologist</w> on behalf of the company following the incident.

traits.comment: Rarely used in modern English in this sense; apologizer is preferred.
